rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a concrete change or alteration, including the resulting changed form.

example.english: This design needs a modification before it suits us.
example.traditional: 呢個設計要改動少少，先至啱我哋用。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 jiu3 goi2 dung6 siu2 siu2 sin1 zi3 ngaam1 ngo5 dei6 jung6

rows.note: Use this when the modification involves editing or correcting text, rules, plans, or other content.

example.english: The contract has undergone a modification based on the lawyer's advice.
example.traditional: 份合約已經按照律師嘅意見作出修改。
example.jyutping: fan6 hap6 joek3 ji5 ging1 on3 ziu3 leot6 si1 ge3 ji3 gin3 zok3 ceot1 sau1 goi2

rows.note: Use this for adjusting an amount, position, arrangement, or setting while keeping the overall thing essentially the same.

example.english: You can make a modification to the height of this seat.
example.traditional: 你可以調整下個座位嘅高度。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 tiu4 zing2 haa5 go3 zo6 wai2 ge3 gou1 dou6
